name: databaseConnect
description: This event is fired when the database has connected

name: giveawayCancel
description: This event is fired when a giveaway was cancelled

name: giveawayEdit
description: This event is fired when a giveaway was edited or its duration changed

name: giveawayEnd
description: This event is fired when a giveaway has ended

name: giveawayEntryAdd
description: This event is fired when a giveaway entry is added

name: giveawayEntryRemove
description: This event is fired when a giveaway entry is removed

name: giveawayEntryRevoke
description: This event is fired when someone tried to enter a giveaway but was refused; use $giveawayDenyReason for why

name: giveawayPause
description: This event is fired when a giveaway was paused

name: giveawayReroll
description: This event is fired when a giveaway was rerolled

name: giveawayResume
description: This event is fired when a paused giveaway was resumed

name: giveawayStart
description: This event is fired when a giveaway has started. With default messages disabled it must $return the ID of the giveaway message it sent
